name: 高中词书
description: 高考核心词汇（人教/北师大教材与高考词表合并）

translations.meaning: 字母A；第一流的；学业成绩达最高标准的评价符号

example.en: Would you like a sandwich?
example.cn: 来块三明治好吗？

example.en: In English we call it an abacus.
example.cn: 在英语里我们叫它为一个算盘。

example.en: He approached life with reckless abandon–I don't think he himself knew what he was going to do next.
example.cn: 他以不计后果的放纵态度对待生活–我想他自己都不知道他接下来要做什么。

example.en: Like other women of the time, Abigail lacked formal education; but her curiosity spurred her keen intelligence, and she read avidly the books at hand.
example.cn: 与同时代其他的妇女一样，阿比盖尔缺乏正式的教育。 但是她的好奇心使她生性聪敏。

example.en: The test measures your mathematical ability.
example.cn: 这种测试考查的是数学能力。

translations.meaning: 能；[经管] 有能力的；能干的

example.en: one of my more able students
example.cn: 我班上能力比较强的学生之一

example.en: abnormal behaviour
example.cn: 反常行为

translations.meaning: 在飞机上；[船] 在船上；在火车上

example.en: The plane crashed, killing all 200 people aboard.
example.cn: 飞机失事，机上200人全部遇难。

example.en: Slavery was abolished in the US in the 19th century.
example.cn: 美国于19世纪废除了奴隶制。

example.en: The abolition of slavery in Brazil and the Caribbean closely followed the pattern of the United States.
example.cn: 巴西和加勒比海地区对奴隶制的废除很大程度上遵循了美国的模式。

example.en: ...Aboriginal art.
example.cn: …土著艺术。

example.en: She decided to have an abortion .
example.cn: 她决定做人工流产。

translations.meaning: 在附近的；四处走动的；在起作用的
大致；粗枝大叶；不拘小节的人

example.en: a book about politics
example.cn: 一本有关政治的书

example.en: Our office is above the hairdresser’s.
example.cn: 我们的办公室在理发店上面。

example.en: I’ve never lived abroad before.
example.cn: 我以前从未在国外生活过。

example.en: an abrupt change of plan
example.cn: 计划的突然改变

example.en: The ground rises abruptly.
example.cn: 地势突然隆起。

translations.meaning: （登山运动员）绕绳下降，悬绳滑锁

example.en: Mick said, 'We would abseil about 200ft down. As the building swayed about you were just left bouncing around on all your ropes.
example.cn: Mick说道：“我们会被绳子吊着下降约200英尺，而大楼会随着风微微摇晃，你只能随着绳子左右摇摆。”

example.en: Ms Leighton will be in charge during my absence (= while I am away ) .
example.cn: 我不在时，由莱顿女士负责。

translations.meaning: 缺席的；缺少的；心不在焉的；茫然的

example.en: The dull, absent look on her face implied boredom.
example.cn: 她脸上呆滞、茫然的神情说明她觉得无聊了。

example.en: I have absolute confidence in her.
example.cn: 我对她充满信心。

example.en: He made his reasons for resigning absolutely clear.
example.cn: 他把辞职的理由讲得一清二楚。

example.en: Plants absorb nutrients from the soil.
example.cn: 植物从土壤中吸收养分。

translations.meaning: 摘要；提取；使……抽象化；转移(注意力、兴趣等)；使心不在焉

example.en: Talking about crime in the abstract just isn’t enough.
example.cn: 抽象地谈论犯罪根本不足以说明问题。

example.en: It seems an absurd idea.
example.cn: 这似乎是个荒唐的想法。

example.en: an abundant supply of fresh water
example.cn: 充足的淡水供应

example.en: She was sexually abused as a child.
example.cn: 她小时候遭到过性虐待。

example.en: He possessed no academic qualifications.
example.cn: 他没有学历。

translations.meaning: 研究院，学术团体；高等专科院校

example.en: the American Academy of Arts and Letters
example.cn: 美国艺术和文学学会

example.en: measures to accelerate the rate of economic growth
example.cn: 加快经济增长速度的措施

translations.meaning: 口音；重音；强调；特点；重音符号

example.en: He had a strong Irish accent
example.cn: 他有浓重的爱尔兰口音。

translations.meaning: 接受；承认；承担；承兑；容纳

example.en: Rick accepted her offer of coffee.
example.cn: 她请里克喝咖啡，他接受了。

example.en: Users can access their voice mail remotely.
example.cn: 用户可以远程获取语音邮件。

translations.meaning: 可接近的；可进入的；可使用的

example.en: The island is only accessible by boat.
example.cn: 这个岛只有坐船才能到。

translations.meaning: 事故；意外；[法] 意外事件；机遇

example.en: I met her quite by accident (= completely by accident ) .
example.cn: 我遇见她完全是偶然。

example.en: The price for the holiday includes flights and accommodation.
example.cn: 度假的价格包括机票和住宿。

example.en: Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult.
example.cn: 14岁以下儿童必须有成人陪同。

example.en: We have accomplished all we set out to do.
example.cn: 所有计划要做的事情，我们都已完成。

translations.meaning: 账户；解释；账目，账单；理由；描述

example.en: My salary is paid into my bank account.
example.cn: 我的工资直接存入我的银行账户。

example.en: The boss dropped an accountant from the payroll.
example.cn: 老板把一名会计师从在职人员名单中除了名。

example.en: It is unjust that a privileged few should continue to accumulate wealth.
example.cn: 少数特权阶级继续积聚财富，这是不公平的。

example.en: He passes the ball with unerring accuracy.
example.cn: 他传球准确无误。

example.en: The brochure tries to give a fair and accurate description of each hotel.
example.cn: 该手册尽量公正、准确地介绍每一家酒店。

example.en: The main accusation levelled against him was that he tried to avoid military service.
example.cn: 对他提出的主要指控是他想逃避兵役。

example.en: The professor stands accused of (= has been accused of ) stealing his student’s ideas and publishing them.
example.cn: 那位教授被指控剽窃学生的观点拿去发表。

example.en: She tried to accustom herself to the tight bandages.
example.cn: 她尝试着使自己习惯那些紧绷的绷带。

example.en: The pans were in their accustomed places.
example.cn: 那些锅在老地方。

example.en: His feet were aching from standing so long.
example.cn: 他站了那么久，双脚隐隐作痛。

example.en: Frances achieved very good exam results.
example.cn: 弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。

example.en: His great achievement is to make all the players into a united team.
example.cn: 他的伟大成就在于把所有选手组织成一支团结的队伍。

example.en: sulphuric acid
example.cn: 硫酸

example.en: The family acknowledge the need for change.
example.cn: 全家人都承认需要改变一下。

example.en: She was a casual acquaintance of my family in Vienna.
example.cn: 她是我们家在维也纳的一个交情不深的朋友。

example.en: Manning hoped to acquire valuable works of art as cheaply as possible.
example.cn: 曼宁希望以尽可能低的价格买到有价值的艺术品。

example.en: the acquisition of language
example.cn: 语言的习得

example.en: They own 200 acres of farmland.
example.cn: 他们拥有200英亩农田。

example.en: Husband: Are they performing acrobatics?
example.cn: 他们在表演杂技吗？

example.en: We can gain some time if we cut across this field.
example.cn: 我们如果抄近路穿过这片田野可以省下一些时间。

translations.meaning: 行为，行动；法令，法案；（戏剧，歌剧的）一幕，段；装腔作势

example.en: I first started acting when I was 12 years old.
example.cn: 我12岁开始演戏。

translations.meaning: 行动；活动；功能；战斗；情节

example.en: The government must take action (= do something ) now to stop the rise in violent crime.
example.cn: 政府现在必须采取行动遏止暴力犯罪的上升。

translations.meaning: 积极的；活跃的；主动的；有效的；现役的

example.en: games for active youngsters
example.cn: 活跃好动的年轻人玩的游戏

example.en: Everyone is free to engage in peaceful political activity.
example.cn: 每个人都可以自由参加和平的政治活动。

example.en: His father was an actor in the Cantonese Opera Company.
example.cn: 他父亲曾是粤剧团的一名演员。

example.en: She's not only a great dramatic actress but she's also very funny.
example.cn: 她不仅是一位伟大的女戏剧演员，而且也很幽默。

example.en: I’m not joking. Those were his actual words.
example.cn: 我没开玩笑，那都是他的原话。

example.en: I’ve known Barbara for years. Since we were babies, actually.
example.cn: 我认识芭芭拉很多年了，实际上我们从小就认识。

example.en: Simon’s vague manner concealed an acute mind.
example.cn: 西蒙貌似蒙昧，其实头脑灵活。

example.en: the first century AD
example.cn: 公元1世纪

example.en: The ability to adapt is a definite asset in this job.
example.cn: 适应能力是做这份工作的绝对有利条件。

example.en: Branagh won two awards for his screen adaptation of Shakespeare's Henry the Fifth.
example.cn: 布拉纳因他对莎士比亚的《亨利五世》的荧幕改编而获了两次奖。

example.en: If the mixture seems dry, add water.
example.cn: 如果混合物看上去干，加点水。

translations.meaning: 沉溺于某种（尤其是不良的）嗜好的；入了迷的，上了瘾的

example.en: Many of the women are addicted to heroin and cocaine.
example.cn: 这些妇女中的很多吸食海洛因和可卡因成瘾。

translations.meaning: 添加；[数] 加法；增加物

example.en: This is a fine book; a worthy addition to the series.
example.cn: 这是一本好书——是对这套丛书有价值的增补。

translations.meaning: 演说；从事；忙于；写姓名地址；向…致辞；与…说话；提出；处理
地址；演讲；致辞；说话的技巧；称呼

example.en: Send a stamped, self-addressed envelope (= with your address on it so it can be sent back to you ) .
example.cn: 寄上一个贴好邮票的、写有回邮地址的信封。

translations.meaning: 阿德莱德（澳大利亚东南部港市，南澳大利亚前首府）

example.en: "We were lucky to find a site like that, " said lead study author Wolfgang Haak, from the University of Adelaide in Australia.
example.cn: “能找到这样的遗址我们真是太幸运了，”来自澳洲阿德莱德大学的主要研究员沃夫冈·哈克说到。

example.en: Farmers have been slow to make adequate provision for their retirement.
example.cn: 农民们迟迟没有为退休做好适当安排。

example.en: Check and adjust the brakes regularly.
example.cn: 经常检查并调节刹车装置。

example.en: a period of adjustment
example.cn: 一段调整期

example.en: We’re looking for someone with experience in administration.
example.cn: 我们正在寻找一个有管理经验的人。

translations.meaning: 令人钦佩的，绝妙的，极好的

example.en: an admirable achievement
example.cn: 令人钦佩的成就

example.en: I really admire the way she brings up those kids all on her own.
example.cn: 我十分佩服她独力把那些孩子抚养大。

translations.meaning: 承认；准许进(加)入；入场费

example.en: Reese, by his own admission , lacks the necessary experience.
example.cn: 里斯自己也承认缺乏必要的经验。

example.en: ‘Okay, so maybe I was a little bit scared,’ Jenny admitted.
example.cn: “行了，也许我是有点害怕。”珍妮承认道。

example.en: Some young people suddenly become self-conscious and tongue-tied in early adolescence.
example.cn: 一些年青人在青春期早期突然变得害羞结舌。

example.en: Young adolescents are happiest with small groups of close friends.
example.cn: 年轻的青春期少年们和一小圈亲近的朋友在一起时最高兴。

example.en: Sally was adopted when she was four.
example.cn: 莎莉四岁时被人收养。

example.en: Betty adores her grandchildren.
example.cn: 贝蒂非常宠爱孙辈。

example.en: Some children find it difficult to talk to adults.
example.cn: 一些孩子觉得与大人很难谈得来。

translations.meaning: 提出；预付；使……前进；将……提前

example.en: a major advance
example.cn: 一项重大进展

example.en: advanced weapon systems
example.cn: 先进的武器系统

example.en: Younger workers tend to be at an advantage (= have an advantage ) when applying for jobs.
example.cn: 年轻点的工人申请工作时往往处于优势地位。

translations.meaning: 冒险；冒险精神；投机活动

example.en: Come on – where’s your sense of adventure?
example.cn: 来吧——你的冒险精神哪里去了？

example.en: an adventurer travelling the world
example.cn: 周游世界的冒险家

example.en: For your viewing pleasure we have included a video clip of a Japanese advert for this abomination.
example.cn: 我们剪辑了一段日本广告的视频让您在视觉上感受这份深恶痛绝。

example.en: They no longer advertise alcohol or cigarettes at sporting events.
example.cn: 他们不再在体育赛事上做烟酒广告了。

example.en: They put an advertisement in ‘The Morning News’, offering a high salary for the right person.
example.cn: 他们在《晨报》上刊登了一则启事，出高薪寻找合适的人选。

example.en: When will advertisers stop bombarding women with images of unattainable beauty?
example.cn: 什么时候广告客户们才会停止用不可企及的美丽形象来持续轰炸女性？

example.en: You should have followed my advice.
example.cn: 你真该听我的建议。

translations.meaning: 建议；劝告，忠告；通知；警告

example.en: She needed someone to advise her.
example.cn: 她需要有个人给她出主意。

example.en: Extremists were openly advocating violence.
example.cn: 极端主义者公开鼓吹使用暴力。

example.en: The aeroplane landed us at the airport in Barcelona.
example.cn: 飞机把我们降落在巴塞罗那机场。

example.en: Are you interested in world affairs?
example.cn: 你对世界大事感兴趣吗？

example.en: the areas affected by the hurricane
example.cn: 受飓风影响的地区

example.en: She looked back on those days with affection .
example.cn: 她深情地回顾那些日子。

example.en: The room affords a beautiful view over the city.
example.cn: 这房间可以俯瞰城市美景。

example.en: There’s no need to be afraid.
example.cn: 没有必要害怕。

example.en: The giraffe ranges in Africa.
example.cn: 长颈鹿生长在非洲。

example.en: ...the African continent.
example.cn: …非洲大陆。

example.en: Tomorrow. Or the day after.
example.cn: 明天。或者后天。

example.en: There’s a meeting on Thursday afternoon .
example.cn: 星期四下午有个会议。

example.en: Shortly afterward, police arrested four suspects.
example.cn: 之后不久，警方逮捕了４名嫌疑犯。

example.en: Charles arrived shortly afterwards .
example.cn: 过了不多久，查尔斯来了。

translations.meaning: 又，此外；再一次；再说；增加

example.en: Can you say that again? I didn’t hear.
example.cn: 你能再说一遍吗？ 我没听见。

example.en: There was a ladder propped up against the wall.
example.cn: 有一把梯子靠在墙边。

translations.meaning: 年龄；时代；寿命，使用年限；阶段

example.en: Francis is the same age as me.
example.cn: 弗朗西斯和我同年岁。

translations.meaning: 代理，中介；代理处，经销处

example.en: a UN agency responsible for helping refugees
example.cn: 负责为难民提供帮助的联合国机构

example.en: The next item on the agenda is the publicity budget.
example.cn: 议程表上的下一项是宣传预算。

translations.meaning: 代理人，代理商；药剂；特工

example.en: Our agent in Rio deals with all our Brazilian business.
example.cn: 我们在里约热内卢的业务代表处理我们在巴西的全部业务。

example.en: an unprovoked act of aggression
example.cn: 无端的侵犯

translations.meaning: 敢作敢为的；侵略的；好斗的

example.en: Jim’s voice became aggressive.
example.cn: 吉姆的声音凶了起来。

example.en: They moved to a new house some time ago (= a fairly long time ago ) .
example.cn: 他们搬进新居已有些日子了。

example.en: During that year of agony and the following year of my grieving, everything stopped for me.
example.cn: 在那一年的痛苦和接下来整整一年的悲恸中，我生活中的一切都停止了。

translations.meaning: 同意，赞成；承认；约定，商定

example.en: Teenagers and their parents rarely agree.
example.cn: 十几岁的孩子跟父母意见很少一致。

example.en: It is easier for two parties to reach agreement than for three.
example.cn: 两方达成一致比三方达成一致容易。

example.en: Farmers struggling for survival strip the forests for agricultural land.
example.cn: 为生存而挣扎的农民们把森林伐光来作农业用地。

example.en: More than 75% of the land is used for agriculture.
example.cn: 75%以上的土地用于农耕。

translations.meaning: 向前地；领先地；在（某人或某事物的）前面；预先；在将来，为未来

example.en: He kept his gaze fixed on the car ahead.
example.cn: 他的目光一直盯着前面的那辆汽车。

example.en: Foreign aid from many countries poured into the famine area.
example.cn: 来自许多国家的救援物资纷纷送到饥荒地区。

translations.meaning: 获得性免疫缺乏综合征；爱滋病（Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome）

example.en: ...people suffering from AIDS.
example.cn: …患有艾滋病的人们。

example.en: The main aim of the course is to improve your writing.
example.cn: 这一课程的主要目的是提高写作能力。

translations.meaning: 空气，大气；天空；样子；曲调

example.en: Let’s go outside and get some fresh air.
example.cn: 我们出去呼吸些新鲜空气吧。

example.en: The return flight of the aircraft was delayed.
example.cn: 飞机的返回航程被推迟了。

example.en: an airline pilot
example.cn: 航空公司飞行员

example.en: Send the letter by airmail.
example.cn: 这封信用航空邮寄。

example.en: The airplane cracked up in landing.
example.cn: 这架飞机在着陆时坠毁。

example.en: The plane landed at Heathrow Airport.
example.cn: 飞机降落在希思罗机场。

example.en: Canadian airspace
example.cn: 加拿大领空

translations.meaning: 阿拉巴马州（美国的一个州）

example.en: One of the latest casualties is the sewer system of Jefferson county, Alabama.
example.cn: 最近的一个受害者是阿拉巴马州杰弗逊县的下水道系统。

example.en: I don’t want to alarm you, but I can’t find the key.
example.cn: 我不想吓你，但我找不到钥匙了。

example.en: Environmentalists are alarmed by the increase in pollution.
example.cn: 不断加重的污染引起环保人士的担忧。

example.en: Like I said, perfect, if you live in Alaska.
example.cn: 像我说过的，完美，如果你住在阿拉斯加的话。

example.en: One of my students from Albany, NY was suffering from bouts of severe depression.
example.cn: 我一个来自纽约奥尔巴尼的学生曾患有严重的抑郁症。

translations.meaning: （收集相片、邮票等的）薄、册，唱片集

example.en: a photograph album
example.cn: 相册

example.en: I don’t drink alcohol anymore.
example.cn: 我不再喝酒了。

example.en: He showed great courage by admitting on television that he is an alcoholic.
example.cn: 他在电视上承认他是个酒鬼，表现出了极大的勇气。

example.en: My behavior is on behalf of half zebras," the algebra teacher said.
example.cn: "我的行为代表了一半斑马的利益,"代数老师说.

translations.meaning: 陌生的；外国的；外星球的

example.en: ...aliens from another planet.
example.cn: …从另一个行星来的外星人。

example.en: My mother and I are alike in many ways.
example.cn: 我和母亲在许多方面很相似。

translations.meaning: 活着的；活泼的；有生气的

example.en: It was a bad accident – they’re lucky to be alive.
example.cn: 这是一宗严重事故——他们能活着实属幸运。

example.en: You shouldn’t be sitting here by yourself, all alone.
example.cn: 你不应该一个人孤零零地坐在这儿。

example.en: an allergic reaction to nuts
example.cn: 对坚果的过敏性反应

example.en: The alley led to the railway bridge.
example.cn: 这条小巷通往铁路桥。

example.en: Tickets are limited and will be allocated to those who apply first.
example.cn: 票数有限，将分配给那些先申请的人。

example.en: We don’t allow diving in the pool.
